# Free art sources

- Quaternius Zombie Apocalypse Kit: https://quaternius.com/packs/zombieapocalypsekit.html — CC0. Imported Matt survivor, Basic zombie and shared atlas from the author's linked public download. Includes skeletal animation clips.
- Kenney Blaster Kit 2.1: https://kenney.nl/assets/blaster-kit — CC0. FBX models and original License.txt included.

Character art is integrated with EMERGENTZ's existing third-person controller; these are art packs, not an imported third-person controller package.
